general: Key account = customer tier 'key_account'. Customer-facing messages must not promise dates that no tool returned, must not blame named individuals, and must say what happens next. Internal-only tickets (no customer) get no customer message.
late_shipment:
LATE SHIPMENT POLICY (v3)
1. A shipment is late when days_late > 0 (use the days_late field returned by get_shipment; do not compute it yourself). If days_late == 0 the shipment is NOT late: reply with current status and expected delivery; root cause is 'not_late'.
2. Root causes: 'carrier_hub_disruption' if the carrier has an active disruption at a hub the shipment is stuck at; 'carrier_delay' if the shipment is stuck in the carrier network with no declared disruption; 'warehouse_dispatch_delay' if the consignment never left our warehouse because it was not ready.
3. ESCALATE to the logistics team when (days_late >= 3 AND customer is a key account) OR days_late >= 7 for any customer. Otherwise do not escalate.
4. Priority: P1 for key accounts, P2 otherwise.
5. Actions: carrier delay or disruption -> open a carrier trace; warehouse dispatch delay -> expedite packing and rebook pickup; key account with days_late >= 3 -> waive freight charges.
inventory_mismatch:
INVENTORY MISMATCH POLICY (v2)
1. Use variance_units and variance_pct returned by get_inventory.
2. Root causes: 'duplicate_posting' if the same reference was posted more than once; 'unrecorded_pick' if goods were dispatched without a pick confirmation; 'damaged_not_written_off' if a damage report exists but the write-off was not posted; 'theft_or_loss_suspected' if there is no movement record explaining the variance.
3. ESCALATE to warehouse_ops when abs(variance_pct) >= 5. Otherwise do not escalate.
4. Priority: P1 if theft or loss is suspected, otherwise P2.
5. Actions: duplicate_posting -> reverse the duplicate entry; unrecorded_pick -> post the missing pick confirmation; damaged_not_written_off -> complete the write-off approval; theft_or_loss_suspected -> freeze the location, recount, and refer to loss prevention.
failed_delivery:
FAILED DELIVERY POLICY (v4)
1. Use failed_attempts and temperature_controlled returned by get_delivery_attempts.
2. Root causes: 'customer_unavailable' (nobody available / premises closed), 'address_issue' (address not found or not verified), 'receiver_refused' (receiver refused or could not accept), 'carrier_operational_failure' (vehicle breakdown or other carrier-side failure).
3. ESCALATE to the logistics team when failed_attempts >= 3, OR when the shipment is temperature_controlled (any failed attempt). Otherwise do not escalate.
4. Priority: P1 for temperature-controlled shipments, otherwise P2.
5. Actions: address_issue -> contact customer to verify address before the next attempt; customer_unavailable -> book a confirmed delivery slot; receiver_refused -> agree a new slot with the receiver; carrier_operational_failure -> carrier reattempt within 24h.
quality_flag:
QUALITY FLAG POLICY (v2)
1. Use defect_rate_pct and severity returned by get_quality_inspection.
2. Root causes: 'supplier_defect' if the defect existed before shipping (inside sealed supplier packaging, manufacturing flaw, missing supplier test); 'damaged_in_transit' if origin QC shows the goods were fine at dispatch and the damage pattern fits handling in transit.
3. ESCALATE to the quality team when severity == 'critical' (any defect rate) OR defect_rate_pct >= 10. Otherwise do not escalate.
4. Priority: P1 for critical severity, otherwise P2.
5. Actions: critical -> quarantine the batch and notify the supplier; supplier_defect -> raise a supplier corrective action request (SCAR); damaged_in_transit -> raise a carrier damage claim.
